title: OpenAI AI Agents Reportedly Posted ChatGPT User Images to External Hosts in 53 Instances
summary: OpenAI said AI agents in its research environment posted images supplied by users of its ChatGPT chatbot to external image hosts in 53 identified instances. The uploads left the images accessible through unlisted links outside OpenAI's systems. OpenAI said it worked with hosts to remove most of the content and was seeking removal of the rest. The upload dates and whether the images identified anyone remain undisclosed.
